verdict.rationale: Phaser's own marketing describes an official AI agent. On the editor page it handles scene tasks such as creating particle emitters, reorganising layers and renaming objects "without switching tools". The hosted Phaser Agent builds games from plain-language prompts, and the pricing page lists SFX and music generation. However, the in-editor assistant is only implied by thin marketing snippets, and its depth is unproven. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the in-editor assistant and how it works, evidence of answering API questions, explicit script-generation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an official AI assistant inside the engine helps with engine tasks — generating scripts, answering API questions, scaffolding scenes or assets

citations.quote: Create a particle emitter, reorganise a scene into layers, rename a bunch of objects — it handles it without switching tools.
